say:1:1310231001:0.text: During the First Divine War, people would wrap snowballs around raspberries and throw them at each other, using the shattered snowballs and jam to symbolize the heads of those terrifying Hypogeans.
say:1:1310231001:0.source_cn: 据说第一次神魔战争时，这里的人会用雪球包裹着树莓互相投...

say:2:1310231002:1.text: After all, the strength of ordinary people was far too weak to confront the Hypogeans directly, so they expressed their hatred in this creative way.
say:2:1310231002:1.source_cn: 毕竟，普通人的力量远远无法与恶魔对抗，只能用这种方式来...

say:3:1310231003:1.text: Eventually, thanks to the bravery of a great general, humanity triumphed.
say:3:1310231003:1.source_cn: 后来因为那位伟大的女将军，人们终于战胜了恶魔。

say:4:1310231004:1.text: Yet the tradition of throwing snowballs endured, evolving into an important ritual of celebration!
say:4:1310231004:1.source_cn: 但投掷雪球的习俗就这么保留了下来，成为庆典上重要的仪式之一！
